_meta.what: Parser golden set (owner: Tudor). One JSON object per line; this first line is metadata - skip it.
_meta.scope_note: Parse each line with exactly these callsigns on frequency (the demo scenario) and the egkk.json fixes/runways.
_meta.compare: Exact match on receiver, intent, self_corrections (default 0) and the ordered instruction list. For each instruction compare only: type, value, turn_dir, verb, constraint, approach_type, runway, fix, unit, frequency, condition, expect_what, report_what. Fields absent here must be null in the parse. Ignore confidence, span, ambiguities, timings.
conventions: text is raw STT output: sometimes spelled-out words, sometimes digits and punctuation; letters of abbreviations may arrive spaced ('i l s', 'q n h').
heading: degrees 1-360 as a number (north = 360). turn_dir only when the controller said left/right.
altitude: value in feet. flight_level: value is the FL number (70 = FL70). A bare level of 1000 or more with no 'altitude'/'flight level' is an altitude.
maintain_level (also 'stop descent/climb'): value is the FL number if a flight level was said, else feet; verb = maintain.
vertical_rate: value in ft/min, verb climb/descend, constraint 'max' for 'or less' and 'min' for 'or greater'. speed uses or_less / or_greater.
expedite is its own instruction (type expedite + verb), in addition to any level instruction.
squawk value is a 4-character STRING (leading zeros matter) or 'ident'. qnh value is a number. contact frequency is a string with 3 decimals.
heading + localiser intercept = two instructions (heading, intercept_localiser). heading + ILS clearance = heading, approach_clearance.
confirm: report_what = level | heading | speed. A conditional puts condition on the inner instruction.
After 'correction' mid-transmission the later value replaces the earlier same-type clause and self_corrections counts it.
receiver null = no callsign resolved (unknown or missing); instructions are still parsed.
_meta.tags_note: tags are for the per-type confusion report only; they are not part of the match.
